note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Every guide, step list and tip is written for this entry in its own words; each trophy names the source its facts come from.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task. Follow the roadmap in order, clear the four missable trophies while their windows are open, and save the 100% completion grind for last. When the final trophy pops, this one pops with it.
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies
Follow the roadmap stages in order
Clear the missable trophies early, 100% last
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through Gone Fishing, the game's opening mission: follow the on-screen objectives, learn the basic controls, and see the intro through to its end. It is unmissable — the trophy pops when the mission's final scene ends. No preparation is needed; just play.
steps: Start a new game
Follow the objectives in Gone Fishing
Finish the mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play every story mission in Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as the story advances; nothing optional is required. If a mission fails, retry it — progress counts when the chapter's final mission completes.
steps: Play all Chapter 1 story missions
Complete the chapter's final mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play every story mission in Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic: the story carries you to it, and a failed mission can simply be retried. Chapter 2 is where the game's open world first opens up, so take the time to learn the map while you play through it.
steps: Play all Chapter 2 story missions
Complete the chapter's final mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play every story mission in Chapter 3 to its end. The chapter ends in Vice City proper, and the trophy pops with the final mission's completion. Nothing here is missable — the story is linear and every mission is replayable from the menu.
steps: Play all Chapter 3 story missions
Complete the chapter's final mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play every story mission in Chapter 4 to its end. Chapter 4 is the longest stretch of the story, so expect several sessions; the trophy is automatic once the chapter's final mission is done, and failed missions can be retried without penalty.
steps: Play all Chapter 4 story missions
Complete the chapter's final mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. Stock up on armour and ammo first and use a manual save before starting it — the finale is long and the last stretch is the hardest fight in the game. The trophy pops when the credits roll, and the mission is replayable if you want a better result.
steps: Buy armour and ammo
Make a manual save before the finale
Complete the final mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission — follow the markers, keep your partner covered during the drive, and don't rush the tail. It unlocks in the normal course of the story and is replayable from the mission menu if you want a better result.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story
Follow the mission markers
Finish the mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist: prep by buying armour and a silenced pistol, stick to the plan the game lays out, and expect a wanted level on the way out — lose it before the mission ends. It is replayable from the mission menu.
steps: Buy armour and a silenced pistol
Follow the heist plan
Lose the wanted level and finish the mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission. Follow the objectives; the stealth section is the only tricky part — move slowly, use cover, and wait for patrols to turn before moving on. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story
Take the stealth section slowly
Finish the mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission. It ends with a set-piece chase — keep your vehicle on the road and don't stop to fight; the mission completes when you reach the marker.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story
Stay on the road during the chase
Reach the marker to finish
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission at the airport. Clear the guards methodically and use the hangars for cover; the mission ends once the target is down and you leave the area. Bring a rifle — the sightlines are long.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story
Clear the guards using hangar cover
Finish the target and leave the area
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission. Bring a rifle with plenty of ammo and body armour — the final room is a sustained firefight with enemies coming from two doors. Hold the doorway and pick them off one at a time.
steps: Stock up on ammo and armour
Hold the doorway in the final room
Finish the mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion counts story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and a set of side objectives — the in-game stats page lists exactly what is still missing, so check it after the story and work through the list. Save this for last: most of it happens naturally while you chase the other trophies. Expect 60+ hours all in.
steps: Finish the story
Open Stats and see what is still missing
Clear the remaining items one by one
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time — the game counts them automatically whenever you drive. The fastest farm is a long straight with a ramp: a fast car, a jump, and repeat. 250 sounds like a lot, but normal play across the story gets you most of the way there, so don't grind it early.
steps: Drive fast and jump, drift and near-miss in normal play
Farm repeats on a runway ramp when close
Reach 250 stunts
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Open the activities menu and try one of each type it lists — fishing, races, the shooting range, drone races, the arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest. Starting one is enough; you don't need to win or finish. This is a good early trophy: it teaches you where everything is.
steps: Open the activities menu
Start one activity of each type listed
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The range has 42 challenges across its weapon stations. Gold needs fast, accurate shooting — take the stationary-target stations first, learn each station's pattern before going for time, and save the moving-target stations for last: they are the hardest. A mouse or a controller with aim assist both work; pick whichever you aim better with.
steps: Gold the stationary-target stations first
Learn each station's pattern, then go for time
Gold all 42 challenges
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race spots around Leonida. Each is a short checkpoint race — learn the course on a slow first run, then race it properly; the drones handle best with gentle stick movements and early braking into turns. Winning at all 14 is what counts, not your times.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race spot
Learn the course slowly, then race it
Win at all 14 locations
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Any race type counts — street, off-road, boat and air races all count, as long as each is a different event. The easiest wins are the short street circuits in a tuned car; repeat wins of the same race don't count, so keep moving to new events.
steps: Enter a race you haven't won
Win it
Win 20 different races
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal's fishing challenge is a timed catch contest: cast where the fish are jumping, reel in steadily without snapping the line, and bank the bigger fish first. A better rod from the bait shop makes it much easier, so buy the upgrade before you challenge him.
steps: Buy a better rod at the bait shop
Cast where fish are jumping
Out-catch Cal before time runs out
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Any arcade cabinet in any arcade counts — pick the shortest game (the side-scroller takes about ten minutes) and play it to its end screen. You don't need a high score, just a completion.
steps: Find an arcade
Pick the shortest game
Play it to the end screen
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's mission strand ends with a final job — it unlocks after his earlier missions, so play his strand through in order. The finale is a driving mission: keep the car intact and follow the route the game marks.
steps: Play Andy's missions in order
Unlock and complete his final mission
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends on the water — the finale is a boat chase. Use the faster boat, cut the corners, and don't stop for the patrol boats; the mission ends at the marked dock.
steps: Play Kenton's missions in order
Take the fast boat and cut corners
Reach the marked dock
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand ends with a solo bike ride. Stay on the bike, follow the route, and the trophy pops when the final scene plays. His earlier missions unlock in order, so there is nothing to look up — just play his strand through.
steps: Play Billy's missions in order
Stay on the bike to the end of the finale
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Stranger missions appear as question marks on the map — eight full strands count. Talk to every stranger you meet, follow each strand to its end, and check the map after each story chapter, since new strangers appear as the story advances. All eight stay available after the story ends.
steps: Talk to every stranger marked on the map
Finish each strand to its end
Complete 8 strands
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends with a delivery run — the finale is timed, so take the shortest route and ignore the side objectives. Play his earlier missions first to unlock it.
steps: Play Randy's missions in order
Take the shortest route on the timed finale
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand ends with a club job — follow the bouncer's directions and the trophy pops at the end of the night. His earlier missions unlock in order.
steps: Play Tyrone's missions in order
Follow the directions in the club finale
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots — quiet viewpoints marked on the map once you find one. Sit through the full session at each; you can fast-travel between them to save time. The beach and mountain spots are the easiest to reach early, so start there.
steps: Find a meditation spot
Sit through the full session
Meditate at all 18 spots
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunt targets one unique animal — it spawns in a marked hunting ground, and only once per in-game day. Save before you go in: if you spook it, it flees and you wait for the next day. A scoped rifle and a quiet approach are the way in. This is one of the four missable trophies — the animal is a one-time spawn, so make a manual save before the hunt.
steps: Make a manual save
Go to the marked hunting ground
Take the unique animal down quietly
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden across Leonida in packs — each set needs its full run of cards. The map's collectibles tab tracks which sets you're close to finishing; start with the set that has the most cards already found. Cards sit in shops, bars and hideouts, so check every interior you enter.
steps: Check the collectibles tab for the closest set
Search shops, bars and hideouts for packs
Complete 3 full sets
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the photo-spot app: stand at a marked location and take the shot. 100 spots are spread over the whole map — the app shows nearby ones, and the in-game checklist shows how many are left per district. Work district by district and you won't backtrack.
steps: Open the WAiNK It app to see nearby spots
Stand at a marked location and take the shot
Photograph all 100 locations, district by district
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's checklist tasks — driving, combat, exploration and activity goals that tick off as you play. Fifty of them is about half the list, and normal play across the other trophies clears most of them without trying. Open the challenges menu to see which easy ones are left.
steps: Play normally — challenges tick off as you go
Open the challenges menu for the easy ones left
Complete 50 challenges
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops — hide in an alley or switch cars and break line of sight. Do this as soon as your partner joins free roam: partners stop being available after certain story points, which is what makes this missable. A manual save before you try is cheap insurance.
steps: Make a manual save while your partner is available
Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you
Break line of sight and lose the cops
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level — keep it at one or two stars, move fast between shops, and don't stop to fight. Same partner window as Hot Together: do both in the same session, before the story moves on.
steps: Pick three shops close together
Rob them back-to-back with your partner
Keep your wanted level the whole way
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Driving a vehicle for the first time 'discovers' it — the vehicles tab counts them. 100 is most of the traffic you'll meet in normal play; car parks, dealerships and the docks are the fastest way to find the rarer ones. Stolen cars count too.
steps: Drive every new vehicle you see
Check car parks, dealerships and docks for rare ones
Discover 100 vehicles
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time for a short window — trigger it in a room with five or more enemies and take them down before it ends. A story warehouse fight has a room full of enemies and is the easiest place to do it; a shotgun helps at close range.
steps: Find a room with five or more enemies
Trigger Combat Focus
Down all five before it ends
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, take a plane or a helicopter and leave without a flight plan — just get airborne from the runway and out over the water. Airport access is restricted after the VCIA story mission, so do it during that mission's window or as soon as you can after it: this is one of the four missable trophies.
steps: Get to VCIA while access is open
Take a plane or helicopter
Leave the airport airspace without a flight plan
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the army tanks that show up at high wanted levels and in one story mission. Take one down — sticky bombs on the rear armour work — or take one for a drive yourself. The story mission is the safest place to meet one, since the tank is scripted there.
steps: Meet a Rhino in the story mission or at a high wanted level
Hit the rear armour with sticky bombs
Take it down or drive it
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store, go in quiet — silenced pistol, no alarms, no witnesses — smash the cases and leave before the cops arrive. If anyone spots you, reload the last checkpoint and try again; the trophy only counts a clean run.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and go in quiet
Smash the cases without tripping an alarm
Leave before the cops arrive
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five bank vaults across Leonida — each is a small heist with a vault to crack and a getaway. Plan the escape route before you go in, keep a fast car nearby, and lose the wanted level before the next one. Vaults unlock as the story advances.
steps: Unlock vaults through the story
Crack a vault with a fast car waiting outside
Escape and repeat for all 5
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around the city — block one, crack it open (explosives work), grab the cash and escape before the wanted level climbs. The downtown route is the easiest to ambush, with narrow streets to block the truck in.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route
Block it and crack it open
Grab the cash and escape
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Leonida has 52 named areas — the map fills in as you visit each one. Drive the highways and back roads systematically; the map's area list shows which districts are still unvisited. The last few are the small islands and the swamp roads, so save those for a dedicated drive.
steps: Drive the highways and back roads
Check the map's area list for gaps
Visit all 52 areas
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations around Leonida — one robbery per gang counts. The operations are marked once you've met the gang in the story; hit the small ones first (they have fewer guards) and keep a getaway car ready.
steps: Meet each gang through the story
Find its marked illegal operation
Rob one operation for all 9 gangs
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and sit with the ocean view. Any bar on the beachfront counts — the trophy pops when the drink animation finishes. It takes two minutes and you can do it any time.
steps: Go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach
Order a cocktail
Sit with the view until the animation ends
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car into a vehicle showroom and smash your way back out through the glass — the 'classic style' is a straight run out the front. Any showroom works, and you can do it any time, so save it for a moment when you don't mind a wanted level.
steps: Drive into a vehicle showroom
Turn around and smash out through the front glass
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game — follow through on the throw (the follow-through animation is the trigger). You don't need a strike; finishing the game is what counts.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Bowl a full game with a follow-through
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is tied to a partnership moment in the story — it pops during a co-op sequence with your partner when the crowd reacts. Just play the story; it unlocks in the normal course of events and can't be missed.
steps: Play the story
Reach the partnership sequence
Let the scene play out
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The game tracks the choices you make — dialogue picks, mission approaches, who you help. PSN tracks a count up to 500, so keep choosing: take the optional dialogue options and the alternate approaches whenever they appear. It accumulates across the whole playthrough, so don't rush it.
steps: Take optional dialogue options
Try alternate mission approaches
Keep choosing until the count reaches 500
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy pops the second time you clear an activity or mission you failed once. It happens naturally during the story; if it hasn't popped, fail a short race once on purpose, then win the rematch.
steps: Fail a short race or activity once
Retry it and succeed
The trophy pops on the second try
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A random strange event out in the world — players report it triggering at night in the swamps and desert roads. Keep playing and exploring at night; it pops when the event finds you. It can take a while, so don't grind for it — let it come while you do other things.
steps: Explore the swamps and desert roads at night
Keep playing — the event triggers on its own
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From a moving vehicle, hit a pedestrian with a melee weapon (a bat works) — the 'bowling' is the ragdoll. A slow drive through a crowded sidewalk makes it easy; the trophy pops on the first clean hit.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a car
Drive slowly along a crowded sidewalk
Land a melee hit from the moving car
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from heists and robberies — launder them through your contacts to clean the money. $250,000 is a lot of dirty cash, so keep every marked bill you find and launder in batches; the contacts menu shows your running total.
steps: Collect marked bills from heists and robberies
Launder them through your contacts
Reach $250,000 laundered
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Any shop spending counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods. $100,000 goes fast once you start upgrading cars and buying guns; if you're short at the end, buy and sell a few expensive items to top it up.
steps: Spend in any shops as you play
Upgrade cars and buy weapons
Reach $100,000 spent
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garages are for sale around Leonida — buy them all. They're marked on the property map; the cheapest ones are in the suburbs, the priciest downtown. You'll need the cash from heists, so save this for the late game.
steps: Open the property map
Buy the suburban garages first
Buy all 8 garages
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles — drive ten different ones to a registration point and register each. Any vehicle counts, so use the ones you find on the street; the app tracks how many are done.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Drive a vehicle to a registration point
Register 10 different vehicles
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
